name: images_replace_background
description: Keeps the main subject and puts it on a NEW background, re-lighting it to match. Describe the new background in `prompt`, or pass `backgroundCreationIdentifier` to use an existing image as the backdrop. A transparent cut-out instead: `images_remove_background`. Then `creations_show`.

backgroundCreationIdentifier.description: Image creation to use as the backdrop; the subject is composited onto it.

folderReference.description: From `folders_list`. Omit → the user's Personal project (refused if `disabled`). Does NOT persist: once the user names a target, pass it on EVERY later generation/edit call.

prompt.description: The new background ("a misty pine forest at dawn"). Required unless a background image is given.

seed.description: Fix the seed to reproduce a result.
